meta.title: PTC delegation mode
meta.description: Adds a "PTC delegation mode" preset: PTC sessions can start subagents through workflow (agent(), parallel(), pipeline()) and get the plan-mode group the shipped ptc preset already has. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 and danger-full-access for workflow runs. It does not restore the missing subagent tool, and it changes no other session.
